notes: Access: curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131 (plain HTTP 403 Akamai on this domain per prior-pass notes). Discovery: homepage/nav has NO direct 'Clearance' link, but the 'Sale' banner links to https://www.habitat.co.uk/events/sale, a marketing hub page (no product-tile/add-to-basket markup on that page itself - genuinely editorial/hub, correctly excluded as its own row) which itself explicitly uses the word 'Clearance.' (image alt text, nav-panel labels) and links out to SIX distinct curated PLPs, all confirmed via embedded sai-product-data JSON (totalNumberOfAllProducts) matching the rendered result-count text exactly on every page. Two genuinely separate Clearance concepts were found on the site, kept as two separate groups (different curation, different product sets - confirmed by product-ID overlap on page 1: Home-Clearance page1 shares 53/60 IDs with the seasonal-clearance page1, i.e. is a near-total subset, while shop-our-clearance-lines-at-habitat shares only 3-6/60 IDs with either - a materially different, narrower cross-category curated set, not an alias): (1) 'Clearance' (shop-home-and-seasonal-clearance, 535) with two site-defined children reached from the same /events/sale hub: Furniture Clearance (115) and Home Clearance (416); 115+416=531 vs parent 535, consistent with the two children being a near-complete partition of the parent (a handful of seasonal-only items not in either child), same pattern as the prior Home-Decor pass's exhaustion checks. (2) 'Clearance Lines at Habitat' (shop-our-clearance-lines-at-habitat, 38, page title 'Results for shop our clearance lines at habitat'), a separate curated cross-category list reached from category-pill filters on the same /events/sale hub, with 5 live category children: Bedding (3), Homeware (23), Kitchenware (8), Lighting (11), Living Room Furniture (6) - union of these 5 children = 37 of the 38 parent IDs (1 extra item, a bed frame, likely under an unexposed 6th category), confirming genuine child listings, not duplicates. A 6th pill, Garden (category:799134), returned 'No results found' (0 products) and was dropped per the zero-product rule. Sale-vs-Clearance test applied per brief: all six rows are the site's OWN taxonomy naming ('clearance' in URL slug, H1, and/or nav-panel label), not a generic temporary % -off promo, so none required the ambiguous-flag treatment. /events/sale itself was NOT recorded as a row (marketing/editorial hub with no product grid of its own).
